quote: ACCIONA Energía has closed today the sale of San Juan de Marcona wind farm (135.7 MW) in Peru to Luz del Sur S.A.A., one of the country's leading energy companies. … The value of the transaction amounts to US$256 million (€218 million).
note: Opened ACCIONA Energía release 16 Dec 2025 (Marcona/Red Coral sale to LDS USD 256m).
